# Third-party material

No new license is applied to the original experiment code in this repository.

AppWorld is maintained by StonyBrookNLP and its contributors. The native source is pinned to `42b5bcf3cd334fee33f0c37c02070a9f5807add5`. Its Apache 2.0 license is retained in APPWORLD-LICENSE. The adjacent patch changes one original agent line to allow an injected configured model; the patch is a modification, not an upstream endorsement.

Protected AppWorld code, data and derivatives have an additional encrypted-redistribution requirement. No decrypted upstream code/data or raw task database is included. Sanitized detailed experiment traces are distributed only in an encrypted .bundle; the plaintext UI uses a restricted metadata projection. See https://github.com/stonybrooknlp/appworld#lock_with_ink_pen-license .

Paper rights are recorded per item in papers/catalog.json. Original PDFs are unchanged. CC BY and CC BY-NC-SA papers retain their authors, attribution and license links. Zep is noncommercial/share-alike; that paper's terms do not relicense the independent experiment code. Papers with only the arXiv nonexclusive distribution license are linked instead of mirrored.
